fig1_chsh_violation.svg: CHSH $|S|$ for the singlet vs a single sweep angle $\phi$ (settings $a,a',b,b'=0,2\phi,\phi,3\phi$), each point from chsh_from_angles. It rises above the local-hidden-variable bound $|S|=2$ (orange, the max over lhv_deterministic_strategies) across $0<\phi\lesssim68.5°$ and peaks exactly at the Tsirelson bound $2\sqrt2\approx2.828$ at $\phi=45°$ — quantum mechanics violates Bell but cannot exceed $2\sqrt2$.
fig2_entanglement_turnon.svg: Entanglement turn-on for $|\psi(\theta)\rangle=\cos\theta|00\rangle+\sin\theta|11\rangle$: concurrence (blue) from concurrence() and the reduced-state purity $\mathrm{Tr}(\rho_A^2)$ (orange) from purity(partial_trace(...)). As $C$ climbs $0\to1$ the purity falls $1\to\tfrac12$ — the product endpoints ($\theta=0,90°$, $\rho_A$ pure) give way to the maximally-entangled Bell state $|\Phi^+\rangle$ at $\theta=45°$, whose reduced state is the maximally mixed $\mathbb I/2$.
